channel.title: GOLFRAW
channel.description: Golf news without the press-release language. Evidence first, opinion labeled.

item.title: Bellerive is 132 yards longer than it was in 2018. Here is where every yard went.
item.description: The BMW Championship 2026 Bellerive setup runs 7,448 yards. We subtracted the 2018 card hole by hole: three holes hold half the added length.

item.title: Jon Rahm PGA Tour return 2027: What is confirmed, what is not
item.description: Jon Rahm PGA Tour return 2027 remains unconfirmed. We trace the PGA rules, his real DP World Tour deal and the 197-day gap since the window shut.

item.title: The Last Man to Win at Bellerive Isn't in the Field
item.description: Koepka won the 2018 PGA at Bellerive. He paid $5m to leave LIV and missed the playoffs entirely. Fifty players arrive at a course he owns the memory of.

item.title: There Are Six Ways to Win Your Club Championship. Only One of Them Is the Club Championship.
item.description: Senior, super senior, flights, gross, net. Most club champions won a division, not the championship. What each one actually means, and who verifies it.

item.title: Bellerive Is a Par 72. The Tour Has Decided It's a Par 70 This Week.
item.description: Detroit spent $16.1m to become a par 70 and gave up three 61s. The Tour has re-parred Bellerive with a pen. The fourth straight par 70, and the longest.

item.title: You Start to Make the Golf Swing More Important Than the Golf Shot
item.description: McIlroy finished 66th of 68 and gave the best explanation of golf's most common trap: when you work on your swing, you stop looking at the target.

item.title: FedEx St. Jude Championship 2026 Prize Money: Scottie Scheffler Takes $3.6M After Eight-Shot Win
item.description: Scottie Scheffler won $3.6M with an eight-shot victory at TPC Southwind. Complete 2026 FedEx St. Jude Championship prize money payouts and FedExCup points.

item.title: The Most Welcoming Golf in America Happens at Charity Scrambles
item.description: No handicap, all abilities welcome, private courses open for the day. Why charity golf tournaments are the easiest way into the game — and how to find one.

item.title: He Finished 66th and Called It Encouraging. He Might Be Right.
item.description: McIlroy never broke par at Southwind and finished 66th. He also got exactly what he came for — and the conversations with the Tour's CEO explain why.

item.title: The FedExCup Money Will Be Decided Before the FedExCup Is
item.description: The ~$100m bonus pool is fully distributed after the BMW Championship. East Lake is a $40m tournament with a trophy attached. What that actually means.

item.title: Fifteen Months Ago He Was Playing NAIA Golf. Today He's in the U.S. Amateur Final at Merion.
item.description: Jack Whaley survived a 16-for-11 playoff just to make the bracket at Merion. Jay Leng Jr. was 2-6-2 in college match play. Now they're playing for the trophy.

item.title: Jon Rahm Has 'Earned' $87.7 Million on LIV. He's Reportedly Owed $150 Million. He Signed for a Reported $300 Million.
item.description: Rahm tops LIV's earnings list at $87.7m — but $36m of that is bonus, and none of it includes his reported $300m signing fee. What the numbers really show.

item.title: Jordan Spieth Made the Playoffs Without a Single Top-10 All Season. He's the Only One.
item.description: Jordan Spieth is the only player to reach the FedExCup Playoffs without a top-10 finish this season. What that says about how golf measures a year.

item.title: Three Tour Players, One Diagnosis, and Only One of Them Fixed It
item.description: Johnson Wagner wants Brian Harman back on his old putter. It's the third case in a fortnight of the same trap — and Scheffler showed the way out of it.

item.title: Maverick McNealy Lost His Season in an Airport Departure Lounge
item.description: Maverick McNealy lost his season in an airport two years ago, projected 50th when he finished. He's back on the same bubble at the same course, by four points.

item.title: 33 Putts and a 68. Then 13 One-Putts and a 61.
item.description: Scheffler tied the TPC Southwind course record with a 61 and leads by three. The seven-shot swing from Thursday was almost entirely on the greens.

item.title: It May Not Be an Investment. It May Be a Loan.
item.description: Every outlet reported LIV secured an investor. Fried Egg Golf says it's a line of credit — debt, which is what broke LIV in the first place. Why that matters.

item.title: Jessica Bang, Australian professional golfer, dies at 18
item.description: Jessica Bang, an 18-year-old Australian golfer in her rookie season on the WPGA Tour of Australasia, has died in Bangkok after suffering a brain haemorrhage.

item.title: Morikawa Shot 61 at the Travelers and Lost by One
item.description: Collin Morikawa's 9-under 61 tied his career low and left him one shot out. Hovland beat Scheffler in a Monday playoff. What actually happened, verified.

item.title: Equity Instead of Cash — and Now the Fines Return
item.description: The DP World Tour is set to resume LIV fines in 2027, a Ryder Cup year. LIV is paying its players in shares. Both jaws of the vice closed in one fortnight.

item.title: The Last Man Into the Playoffs Tees Off First. Alone.
item.description: Jackson Koivun plays as a single at 8:10 a.m. after Berger's withdrawal. Scheffler and McIlroy go at 9:30. Full round one tee times from TPC Southwind.

item.title: McIlroy Didn't Need Memphis. He Turned Up
item.description: McIlroy is 12th in the FedExCup and safe either way. He skipped Memphis last year and drew criticism. This time he mentioned talking to the Tour's new CEO.

item.title: LIV Cancels Its Finale. Tickets Remain on Sale
item.description: LIV has told players the $40m Michigan Team Championship is off — but its own website is still selling tickets, and nobody knows who wins the team title.

item.title: The Priciest Golf Search in America Gets 40 Hits
item.description: "Golf deals fairmont st andrews" costs $9.06 a click on 40 monthly searches. "Black friday golf deals" costs 95 cents on 3,600. Why value runs backwards.

item.title: A Home Solheim Cup, and the Dutch Star Can't Play
item.description: Dewi Weber is ranked ahead of three of Europe's captain's picks. She can't be selected for the Solheim Cup in her own country because of an LET rule.

item.title: He Shot 59. It Only Got Him Into a Playoff
item.description: Frankie Harris shot 12-under 59 to win the Pinnacle Bank Championship — but Docherty birdied his last three to force extra holes. Only nine have done it.

item.title: He Won at 25 Under. This Week Is the Opposite
item.description: Koivun won the 3M Open at 25 under. TPC Southwind has seven par 4s over 450 yards and water on 11 holes. The first real test of a 21-year-old's season.

item.title: A Rolled-Back Ball Made Him One Yard Longer
item.description: Cameron Young averages 312 yards this year using a ball that meets the 2030 rules — one further than last season. Why golf's rollback just got paused.

item.title: The Tournament the Tour Demoted Is the Hardest One
item.description: Detroit gave up three 61s. Sedgefield gave up 36 rounds under 66. TPC Southwind is the same par and the hardest of the three — and it's being relegated.

item.title: "Pathetic." Also: "10 Out of 10." Same Interview
item.description: Koepka called his season pathetic and rated his happiness 10 out of 10, minutes apart. What his return from LIV actually cost, and what went wrong.

item.title: Three Feet vs. Six: The Putting Gap
item.description: Tour players hole 99.42% from three feet and 70.98% from six. Everything about three-putting is which one you leave yourself. The data, and what to do.

item.title: Playing With a Pro Costs $10,000. Or $200
item.description: PGA Tour pro-ams run $2,500–$10,000 a head. Your local PGA section runs them for $200–$400, at private clubs. How pro-ams work and what pros expect of you.

item.title: The Winning Team Finished Six Over Par
item.description: Crushers GC won LIV New York at six over — the highest winning team score in league history. Niemann took the individual title wire to wire at 16 under.

item.title: No, Scheffler Isn't at a Disadvantage at East Lake
item.description: The FedExCup leader no longer starts 10 under at the Tour Championship. That isn't a disadvantage — it's no advantage. Why the difference matters in 2026.

item.title: Michigan Pro Golf Faces an Uncertain Future in
item.description: Michigan could lose three men's pro golf events before 2027. See the latest on the Rocket Classic, LIV Golf, Ally Challenge and LPGA stops.

item.title: Westwood Is 53, Four Back, and Done With
item.description: Everyone ran the 'brain-dead' quote. The one after it is better: Westwood on why he stopped setting expectations — and he's four off the lead at 53.

item.title: Lowest Round in LET History Friday. Four-Putt
item.description: Charley Hull shot 62 to equal the lowest round in Ladies European Tour history, then four-putted the 17th while leading. Anna Huang, 17, eagled the last.

item.title: Eighth in Iron Play, 116th in Putting
item.description: Koepka is 8th on Tour in approach play and 116th in putting. He withdrew from Detroit with a hand injury. Now he needs a massive week at Sedgefield.

item.title: Playing Golf in Your Fifties: Distance Loss
item.description: Playing golf in your 50s means less carry and longer approaches. Learn when to move up a tee and choose yardage that protects your score.

item.title: 6 and 5 on Thursday. Beaten on the 19th on Friday
item.description: Rianne Malixi beat the world No. 14 amateur by six and five, then lost on the 19th hole the next day. What match play does that stroke play never does.
